channel.title: Jiǎoluò Shūwū · 角落書屋
channel.description: A reading nook for Chinese language and civilisation. Characters, vocabulary, grammar, history, philosophy, and the world they shaped.

item.title: 饱 · full, satisfied, to eat one's fill
item.description: The food radical 饣 wraps the sound of 包 (bāo), so the glyph itself is a stomach packed full like a dumpling.

item.title: 报 · to report, to announce; newspaper; to repay
item.description: A hand cuffing a kneeling criminal once meant sentencing; today the same glyph carries newspapers, reports, and the moral arithmetic of repayment.

item.title: 病 · illness, disease, to fall ill, fault
item.description: A person sweating on a sickbed with the phonetic 丙 inside: the radical 疒 frames every Chinese word for being unwell.

item.title: 草 · grass, herb, straw; draft, rough
item.description: A field of grass under the morning sun: the grass radical over 早 zǎo (early) gives the plant its sound, and from the meadow grow the senses of herb, straw, and a hasty rough draft.

item.title: 唱 · to sing, to chant, to call out
item.description: A mouth beside the sun-doubled 昌: the radical names the act of singing while 昌 carries only the sound.

item.title: 穿 · to pierce, to bore through, to wear, to put on
item.description: A tooth gnawing through the roof of a cave: one image for boring a hole and for the body slipping into clothing.

item.title: 船 · ship, boat, vessel
item.description: A pictophonetic built on 舟 (boat): the hull carries the meaning while the right side supplies the sound, covering every craft from sampan to ocean liner.

item.title: 春 · spring, springtime, vitality, the stir of desire
item.description: Sun pressing up through young shoots: the season of growth, and the oldest Chinese metaphor for life-force and erotic longing.

item.title: 错 · error, mistake; wrong, incorrect
item.description: A metal character whose oldest sense was inlay and grinding; from crossed, interlocking lines it slid to things crossing wrongly, the modern sense of error.

item.title: 蛋 · egg, egg-shaped thing, scoundrel
item.description: A pictophonetic egg: the 虫 radical for small creatures sits under a sound element, and in slang it turns people into scoundrels.

item.title: 灯 · lamp, lantern, light
item.description: A fire radical 火 fused with the sound 丁, naming everything from oil lamps to the red light that stops traffic.

item.title: 懂 · to understand, to know, to grasp
item.description: A heart-radical verb where comprehension is felt, not just decoded: to truly get something is to take it in inwardly.

item.title: 短 · short, brief; deficient, lacking
item.description: An arrow set beside a ritual bean-pot measures the short distance, so 短 builds its meaning of brevity from a comparison of two small lengths.

item.title: 队 · team, group, band, military unit; measure word for groups
item.description: A crowd of people 人 packed against an earthen mound 阝, the image that gives 队 its sense of a formed-up team or column.

item.title: 房 · building, house, room
item.description: A door radical leaning over the phonetic 方: the side-chamber under a roof that grew into every word for house, room, and the family branches that fill them.

item.title: 飞 · to fly, to dart; high, swift
item.description: A single bird caught mid-flap, one outstretched wing and the rising line of its body, frozen at the instant it leaves the ground.

item.title: 封 · to seal, envelope, to confer (a fief)
item.description: A handful of earth heaped over a boundary mound, sealed by hand: 封 ties envelopes, granaries, and feudal grants to the same gesture of closing something off.

item.title: 富 · rich, wealthy, abundant, to enrich
item.description: A full wine jar tucked under a roof: the picture of a household storehouse packed to its rafters with plenty.

item.title: 父 · father, male elder, household head
item.description: A hand gripping a stone axe: the tool of the one who heads the household, drawn as the figure of the father himself.

item.title: 改 · to alter, to change, to correct, to reform
item.description: A hand raises a stick over a kneeling child: 改 is change enforced by correction, not drift, which is why it leans toward fixing what is wrong.

item.title: 哥 · elder brother, a familiar term for an older young man
item.description: Two 可 stacked into one glyph; the doubled phonetic came to carry the warmest word in the family, elder brother.

item.title: 歌 · song, lyrics; to sing, to chant
item.description: The radical 欠 (an open, exhaling mouth) drives the meaning of song, while 哥 supplies the gē sound.

item.title: 狗 · dog
item.description: A pictophonetic glyph where the beast radical 犭supplies the meaning and 句 lends only the sound, naming the most domesticated of animals.

item.title: 馆 · a public building, hall, shop, establishment
item.description: A food-radical building: the eating-house that grew into the library, the museum, and the embassy.

item.title: 孩 · baby, child, children
item.description: A child-radical fused with the earthly branch 亥: 子 carries the meaning, 亥 lends the rising sound hái.

item.title: 害 · to harm, injury, calamity, to fear
item.description: Under the roof a mouth and a blade build the sense of injury done; the same glyph also means to fear, as in 害怕.

item.title: 喝 · to drink; (hè) to shout, to cry out
item.description: A mouth radical paired with the phonetic 曷, splitting cleanly into the everyday hē you drink with and the older hè you shout with.

item.title: 河 · river, the Yellow River
item.description: 河 began as the personal name of one river, the Yellow River, before it widened to mean any river at all.

item.title: 湖 · lake, the provinces around Dongting
item.description: A water radical against the phonetic 胡, naming every still inland water from West Lake to the jianghu of wandering swordsmen.

item.title: 坏 · bad, rotten, spoiled; to break down
item.description: A picto-phonetic built from 土 earth and 不 not: spoiled soil that yields nothing, extended to anything gone bad or broken.
